book.kogasa_addiction_compat.category.co: Master switch, combining and the rainbow crystal.
book.kogasa_addiction_compat.entry.overv: The master switch is $(6)compat.enableCompatEquipment$(0) (enabled by default). Only whitelisted items get Kogasa mechanics: $(li)Kogasa's own equipment; $(li)items combined with a rainbow crystal; $(li)items added to the $(6)#kogasa_addiction_compat:compatible$(0) item tag by a datapack.

To combine: pick up a rainbow crystal with your cursor, then $(6)right-click$(0) the target item slot in your inventory. Survival consumes 1 crystal; creative only marks the item.$(br2)Compatible items gain growth, reinforcement, sealing and attribute bonuses, and their tooltip shows Kogasa's stat lines.
book.kogasa_addiction_compat.entry.rainb: Rainbow ore only generates high up (above Y 128), following iron ore's style, and needs a stone pickaxe or better. Without silk touch it drops 1 rainbow crystal.

Drop a rainbow crystal into $(6)lava$(0) or a $(6)lava cauldron$(0) to convert it into a random ability ingot, with a configurable chance (100%% by default).$(br2)See the $(6)rainbow$(0) config section.
book.kogasa_addiction_compat.manual.land: This addon lets growth, reinforcement, sealing and attribute mechanics apply to other mods' tools and weapons — but by default only to items combined with a rainbow crystal.
book.kogasa_addiction_compat.manual.name: Kogasa Addiction: Compat Manual
item.kogasa_addiction_compat.rainbow_cry: §7Pick up the crystal with your cursor, then right-click a target item in the inventory to combine it and enable all Kogasa mechanics
§8Drop into lava / lava cauldron to convert into a random ability ingot
message.kogasa_addiction_compat.combined: Combined rainbow crystal with %s: all Kogasa mechanics are now enabled on it
